column1: # path<TAB>job<TAB>backlog digest<TAB>reason. Only relay-backlog keys frozen
# in the checker may appear; no pull_request job may be listed.
# Relay backlog (#1831). Jobs a relay event (workflow_dispatch, workflow_call,
# repository_dispatch) reaches that can resolve to a persistent runner, present
# before ADR 0235 scanned relays. The digest here is the backlog digest:
# SHA-256 over the job's full content, its callers, its inherited settings,
# its unresolved reason names, and every scanned-tree byte the job puts on
# disk: the files its sparse checkouts list and its local actions hold, links
# as their target text, these two lists excluded. A backlog job may not check
# out this whole tree or materialize tracked content with git show, archive,
# or cat-file (a show of a file its own sparse list holds at the dispatch
# commit excepted); such a job fails whatever its row says, except that
# release.yml verify alone tolerates a full checkout and binds instead the
# programs it runs (tree_programs; Part of #1831). A standalone
# workflow_call job's default checkout is its caller's repository, which no
# row can bind. The keys are frozen in public-pr-runner-isolation.py
# (RELAY_BACKLOG), which also names the refusal kinds each tolerated then;
# refusals are decided before this list is read. No row may be added without
# that code change; each leaves by moving to the ephemeral lane or, when head
# detection finds no pattern, by gaining a reviewed entry.
